description: Na₂TlCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.68 Å. Tl is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TlO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Tl-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.36 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.27-1.33 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent TlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-66°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.59 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Tl, and one C atom to form distorted ONa₂TlC trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂TlP tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ONa₂TlC trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Tl, and one C atom to form distorted ONa₂TlC trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂TlP tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ONa₂TlC trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Tl, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Tl, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Tl, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂TlP tetrahedra.
